briefing.headline: OpenAI o4-preview and DeepSeek R2 intensify AGI race as compute bottlenecks tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push multimodal reasoning boundaries while regulatory scrutiny grows in the US and EU. Funding remains robust but compute scarcity is reshaping alliances. DialectForge emerges as a protocol-level counter to persistent injection threats.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with 12% gains on GPQA; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus hits internal 85% on SWE-bench; Google Gemini 3 and Meta's Llama 4 trail slightly while xAI Colossus cluster enables Grok-3 training runs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST updates draft guidelines; new jailbreak variants reported against o3 successors.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm for NVIDIA Blackwell; Microsoft and Google announce $45B combined data-center spend; UAE sovereign fund partners on 100k H100 cluster.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first model to reach 95% on ARC-AGI trigger mandatory international oversight by Q2 2027?
